name: Glare Sensitivity
definition: The ability to see objects in the presence of a glare or bright lighting.

benchmark.name: WildDash
benchmark.model_or_system: MSeg-1080 (HRNet-W48 trained on MSeg composite, zero-shot to WildDash)
benchmark.human_reference: General working adults with normal vision performing visual tasks in bright or glare conditions, such as drivers and outdoor or field workers.

benchmark.name: GLARE
benchmark.metric: mAP@0.5:0.95 (percentage points) on the GLARE test set
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population, specifically typical licensed drivers who must see and identify traffic signs under sun glare

benchmark.human_reference: General adult drivers with normal vision who recognize traffic signs under sun glare while driving
